notes.title: Xbox Controller Support
notes.notes: Partial Xbox controller support was recently added. The trees on the Switzerland map now have collisions. That's all for this update!

notes.title: Performance Issues Fixed on Switzerland
notes.notes:
Switzerland is officially playable, in a literal sense. The game will not lag so bad that you are unable to finish the track.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40762147/1d2beb247ace21fc6e0480fc579888d46e1614f3.png[/img]

notes.title: Switzerland Map Releasse
notes.notes: The Switzerland map has been released! Expect performance issues that will be fixed in due time! In the meantime, can you brave the Swiss Alps?

notes.title: Bug Fix - Out of Bounds
notes.notes: Southern California and Philadelphia maps now have invisible boundaries, to prevent you from driving off the map.
